content: The recent work BIBREF6 introduced a unifying perspective of reformulating maximum likelihood supervised learning as a special instance of a policy optimization framework. In this perspective, data examples providing supervision signals are equivalent to a specialized reward function. Since the original framework BIBREF6 was derived for sequence generation problems, here we present a slightly adapted formulation for our context of data manipulation.
